info.title: AMDN Foundation contract proposal
info.description: F0.4 review artifact only. No messaging endpoints or production crypto profile are implemented/approved. See http-api.md and authorization.md; A01–A07, E01–E06 and N01/N02 remain pending.

servers.description: Non-routable documentation placeholder, not a deployment.

post.description: Implemented F1.3 subset, disabled until explicitly configured. Production rollout and review gates remain pending.
post.x-authorization: Separate platform provisioning identity/grant; tenant owners denied.
post.x-rate-limit: Explicit process-local endpoint/actor budgets; verified tenant reads and durable provisioning capacity quotas. Distributed enforcement and A06 approval pending.

post.description: Proposed F1.4 contract; Gateway implements this route only with explicit EnrollmentApi configuration (disabled by default). See ../../README.md for current implementation status. See device-enrollment.md for proof order, strict parsing, expiry, replay and atomic effects. All responses, including errors, require Cache-Control: no-store.
post.x-authorization: Verified issuer/sub/client_id; active tenant/user/membership/postman, fresh configured step-up and explicit current device.manage object grant on every request and replay. Bind exact initiating origin and stored RP configuration; recheck after lock waits.
post.x-idempotency: Tenant/user/operation/ceremony/stage/key and exact request bytes, including authenticated client/origin binding. Begin uses operation/target namespace before ceremony ID exists. Different bytes conflict; consumed/expired pending options cannot be replayed; completed effects never repeat.
post.x-rate-limit: Configured actor/tenant/global budgets; one unfinished enrollment or revocation ceremony per tenant/user; five reserved verification attempts per stage; no unlimited defaults.

200.description: Stage committed or authorized replay. Pending replay allowed only while its returned challenge remains current and unexpired; completed replay returns historical effect with fresh lifecycle snapshot.

accessToken.bearerFormat: Access token; issuer/provider and device binding pending A02
accessToken.description: Verify identity and active membership, then enforce each operation scope and object grant. Documentation is not enforcement.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Scoped to authenticated actor/operation; retries must use identical request bytes. Conflict returns 409.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Strong ETag for expected policy version. Missing or malformed is 400; stale is 412.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque token bound to tenant, user, device/view and snapshot; expired tokens return 410.

DeviceTenant.name: tenant_id
DeviceTenant.description: Selector only. Resolve through verified issuer/subject and active membership; never authority.

CeremonyOrigin.name: Origin
CeremonyOrigin.description: Exactly one canonical configured HTTPS origin, no path or trailing slash; exact allowlist match and binding to initiating origin required. Reject null/multiple values. Syntax alone is not authorization; never derive RP/origin from Host or forwarding headers.

Error400.description: Invalid request shape, encoding or semantic fields.

Error403.description: Authenticated actor lacks the required action.

Error409.description: Idempotency, device/key snapshot or delivery-state conflict.

Error410.description: Cursor no longer retained; restart scoped snapshot.

Error413.description: Encoded or decoded request size limit exceeded.

Error503.description: Transient inability to perform the operation.

Error415.description: Unsupported media type or content encoding.

Address.description: Verified delivery alias; normalization/reassignment require A02 review. Not an authorization key.

Profile.description: Syntactic identifier only. No production profile is approved; server admission requires a reviewed allowlist.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem with safe stable code. No private resource details or internal exception text.

WebAuthnCredentialId.description: Canonical unpadded base64url; decoded limit 1023 bytes.

WebAuthnClientData.description: Canonical unpadded base64url; decoded limit 8192 bytes.

WebAuthnAttestation.description: Canonical unpadded base64url; decoded limit 16384 bytes.

WebAuthnAuthenticatorData.description: Canonical unpadded base64url; decoded limit 4096 bytes.

WebAuthnSignature.description: Canonical unpadded base64url; decoded limit 1024 bytes.

WebAuthnChallenge.description: Exactly 32 bytes, canonical unpadded base64url. Generated by the server; never client-selected.

ExpectedDeviceVersion.description: Current identity version, including after revocation. Maximum reserves room for one atomic increment.

WebAuthnRegistration.description: AMDN projection of browser credential fields, not the complete browser toJSON object. id must equal rawId and the verified attested credential ID. Client adapter copies raw signed bytes without reserialization; see device-enrollment.md.

WebAuthnAssertion.description: id/rawId must equal the single allowed stored credential ID. Absent/null userHandle is allowed only for the already identified owner; otherwise exact stored handle required. No client extensions.

WebAuthnCreationOptions.description: Browser publicKey options after base64url decoding. Explicit configured RP ID; pseudonymous user labels. Exclude only the current credential if any; server uniqueness covers all retained credentials. No extensions requested; no authenticatorAttachment restriction.

EnrollmentRegistrationOptions.description: Pending ceremony snapshot. device_id is candidate for enrollment, current device for revocation. Options cannot be replayed after the challenge expires or is consumed. Server deadlines override browser timeout.

EnrollmentCandidateOptions.description: Pending ceremony snapshot. device_id is candidate for enrollment, current device for revocation. Options cannot be replayed after the challenge expires or is consumed. Server deadlines override browser timeout.

EnrollmentCurrentOptions.description: Pending ceremony snapshot. device_id is candidate for enrollment, current device for revocation. Options cannot be replayed after the challenge expires or is consumed. Server deadlines override browser timeout.

RevocationOptions.description: Pending ceremony snapshot. device_id is candidate for enrollment, current device for revocation. Options cannot be replayed after the challenge expires or is consumed. Server deadlines override browser timeout.

EnrollmentCompleted.description: Historical credential activation plus current lifecycle snapshot for this device and current owner identity version. Never authorizes messaging or reactivates a superseded device; no key_id.

RevocationCompleted.description: Historical revocation plus current lifecycle. Revocation is terminal; no reenrollment or messaging authority.

public_key_package.description: Unpadded canonical base64url. Semantic validation must decode strictly and enforce byte limits.

DirectoryEntry.description: Authorized public projection. Clients still need independent first-contact/key-change verification.

ciphertext.description: Unpadded canonical base64url. Semantic validation must decode strictly and enforce byte limits.

SubmitMessage.description: Sender identity and envelope ID are server-derived. Validate expiry against server admission time and recipient snapshot under current policy. Proposed wire shape, not an approved crypto adapter.

Envelope.description: Immutable server-derived identity plus submitted sealed data. Server metadata is not retrospectively authenticated sender data.

AckRequest.description: Device ID must match authenticated active credential and addressed delivery. Ack claims durable sealed-record storage, not decryption or reading.
